What's on your mind?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I just found out that I didn't get the scholarship I applied for."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I'm so sorry to hear that. You must be really disappointed."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Yeah, it's just frustrating. I really thought this would be my chance to ease some of the financial pressures of grad school."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I can imagine. It's tough when you're expecting something that could make life a bit easier and it doesn't come through."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Exactly. And it just feels like a setback after working so hard, especially after everything with my thesis."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"You've been through a lot recently, with the criticism on your thesis and the group project issues. It's okay to feel upset about this."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Thanks. I guess I just keep thinking about all the time and effort I put into the application. It feels like it's always something."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Your dedication is amazing, Kelly. Even if this didn’t work out, it doesn’t take away from all the effort you’ve put in."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"It's hard to keep that perspective when these things happen back to back. It just adds to feeling stuck, you know?"},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Absolutely, and it's important to acknowledge that feeling. Have you thought about what you might do next?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I'm trying to keep my options open. There's the internship offer, but I'm not sure about committing to it right now."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's understandable to feel conflicted. The internship could be a valuable experience, but it's okay to take your time deciding."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I appreciate you saying that. I guess I'll think on it more after this initial disappointment passes."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's a healthy approach, Kelly. It's important to give yourself space to process everything."}]
